description_en: Deletes a subscriber of a partition expression. After the subscriber is deleted, the subscriber no longer receives notifications when a data quality monitoring rule is triggered
description_zh: 调用DeleteQualityFollower接口，删除分区表达式的订阅用户。删除后，当数据质量的监控规则被触发，该订阅用户将不会再收到通知消息
name: DeleteQualityFollower

parameters.help_en: The name of the engine or data source where the partition expression resides. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the rule configuration page of Data Quality to obtain the name
parameters.help_zh: 分区表达式所在的引擎或者数据源的名称。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入数据质量的规则配置页面获取名称
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the subscription relationship for the partition expression. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/174000.html operation to obtain the subscription relationship ID
parameters.help_zh: 分区表达式的订阅关系ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/174000.html接口获取订阅关系ID
parameters.name: follower_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console and go to the workspace configuration page to obtain the workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

Data.description_en:
Indicates whether the subscriber of the partition expression was successfully deleted. Valid values:
true: The subscriber was deleted.
false: The subscriber failed to be deleted. You can check the error message to identify the cause and resolve the issue
Data.description_zh:
是否成功删除分区表达式的订阅用户，取值如下：
true，删除成功。
false，删除失败，您可以通过报错信息查询原因，处理问题

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the subscriber of the partition expression fails to be deleted
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 删除分区表达式订阅用户失败后的报错信息

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used for subsequent troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用于后续错误排查使用

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。取值如下：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
